asr.full_text: Crypto markets are super uncertain right now but one thing I do know for sure is that there are quality projects that are continuing to build and one of those is Chainlink. As I'm currently at Chainlink's New York SmartCon event. So I'm going to tell you all of the crazy announcements that were dropped that are bullish long-term In under five minutes, because there's a lot and I'm honestly having trouble keeping up myself. Now, when do I talk everything crypto every single day single day like this video drop me a comment and of course subscribe and set alerts so you don't miss anything and i know i'm supposed to be live streaming this morning but i had a personal obligation i'd take care of so i figured i would just give you guys all the crazy things that chainlink's been working on because that's a lot so let's go ahead and discuss the day one smart con wrap up or recap chainlink runtime environment basically it's an all-in-one valera that's powering on chain finance and as we know the traditional financial markets are really excited about integrating crypto primarily stablecoins right now so they're basically utilizing chainlink's technology for this Aka Tokenization. Chainlink UBS an end-to-end tokenized fund work for leveraging the chain link dta technical standard again more foundation being built via tokenization because everything's gonna be tokenized in the near future this is the narrative that tribe is talking about so it's important to understand exactly kind of how these things work and i understand it's a little bit technical a little bit too technical for me but at the end of the day it is important to have a basic understanding that's what we do on this channel now this one's the most important one to me personally as somebody who absolutely loves privacy, advocates for it, because you have to remember in crypto, we can only stay pseudo anonymous. Chain links, confidential compute, private smart contracts on any blockchain. The keyword here is privacy. Then we have smart contracts and then any blockchain. This is interoperability, but it is in a private manner. Not only is this going to be really important for institutions moving forward, but it is going to be incredibly important for average people retail like you and me because our privacy does matter and we deserve to be able to retain it and the fact that it's interoperable is absolutely amazing because there's a lot of different projects that utilize chainlink and they all have to be able to talk to each other and we've seen interoperability with hedera and with cardano those are just some to name and you can't fully change the future of finance if you don't have the ability to communicate effectively with other entities and in this case blockchains oh and ripple do sorry guys a very popular liquid staking protocol lido just announced the integration of ccip well excuse me they are upgrading to chainlink ccip as the official cross chain infrastructure for WS Teeth across all chains again more interoperability and integration with defy which again is going to be incredibly important because defi is going to be the last frontier for any of us to have a shot at just any sort of level playing field retail that is then they announced that wisdom tree that manages $130 billion AUM adopted Chainlink to bring institutional grade NAV data on-chain to power subscriptions and redemptions for CRDT, tokenized fund on Ethereum. Again, tokenization. And we have big names like WisdomTree that are utilizing this technology. It gives an indication of what they're paying attention to. So yes, ChainLink did initially start out as a really great Oracle provider, but at the same time, they're able to really kind of capture that entire market and they moved on. Well, they're still focused on that, but they're also moving on to interoperability and to privacy and to just really integration with all the different crypto projects and traditional finance. So go ahead and comment what you are most bullish on that ChainLink is working on and i don't want to hear about price action because while sergey was talking price was dumping and we all know that you know the whole entire market is not doing super great in it right now but that's okay comment your thoughts below but not about price we're here for utility
